## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

Identify the affected app/platform and any shared branding or repository changes.

## Validation

List commands and environments actually checked, results, failures and checks not run. Distinguish historical evidence from new results.

## Security and compatibility

Describe effects on data ownership, cancellation, privacy, compatibility and dependencies. Exclude credentials and personal data. Update relevant docs and retain third-party notices.

## AI usage

Disclose material AI assistance (analysis, documentation, code or tests) and the checks actually verified.
